name: TinyZKP Receipt Share Contract
purpose: Document the public verifier share-link format used by TinyZKP receipts, playground proofs, and agent-generated receipt URLs.

fragment.browser_network_boundary: The URL fragment is not sent to TinyZKP or any HTTP server when the verifier page loads. If the user clicks Verify and local WASM verification cannot verify the receipt, the page may send the proof object to TinyZKP's hosted verifier fallback.

data_boundaries: Default public TinyZKP receipts are transparent state-transition receipts.
Do not put secrets, API keys, private customer data, raw credentials, regulated records, or unsupported private witness material into a share URL.
A valid receipt proves the encoded statement, not off-chain context that was not encoded into the proof statement.
For receipts too large for a share URL, share the proof JSON through a safe channel and verify it at https://tinyzkp.com/verify.
human_and_agent_guidance: Use a receipt-share URL when the verifier should independently check a proof without access to the producer system.
Preserve source=receipt_share on CTA links created from receipt shares.
Prefer /verify share links for demo, support, audit, and agent-output contexts where the proof object is safe to disclose.
Escalate to a custom workflow before sharing receipts that require hidden inputs, custom statements, or regulated data handling.
